sources.title: Internal travel reimbursement policy
sources.content: Internal travel policy version 4. For actual-receipt business trips, reimburse only employee-paid lodging and standard rail fares linked to the employee and trip. Use the sum of the eligible receipt amounts, in USD, with a total trip limit of USD 200.00. Personal purchases, daily allowances and company-paid charges cannot be added to this actual-cost claim. The ERP claim must still be UNPAID. The employee's registered manager must sign approval for the same claim, trip and total; employees cannot approve their own claims. This policy does not establish per-diem entitlement.
